speech.heard: In Niger, 0.5% of adult women finished university. In Lithuania, it's 46.4%. It counts the percentage of population ages 25 and over that attained or completed bachelors or equivalent. China has 7.4%, while India has 11.7%. Climbing higher, USA has 40.5%, UK has 40.9%, Russia has 42.8%, and Lithuania has 46.4%. At the very top, UAE has 56.8%. That gives UAE 7.7 times what China has. What percentage of women hold degrees in your country?
